verdict.rationale: Reliability analytics is a fair axis for an incident-management and on-call platform, but the evidence pack never documents MTTA/MTTR trend reporting, incident-load dashboards, or on-call health metrics. A community remark that incident volume made metrics 'look bad' does not show Rootly's own analytics capability. The docs cover alerting, on-call scheduling, workflows, retrospectives and AI, but not analytics.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I get reliability analytics — MTTA/MTTR trends, incident load, on-call health — to see whether we are actually improving
